messages:
alex: heads up — after the west2 cluster migration we're seeing a spike in prometheus remote_write errors from gpu-node-pool
mia: saw that, p95 write latency jumped to ~18s and a few 504/timeouts, right?
jon: yup. graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/remote-write/cluster-writes (shortlink)
lisa: quick dump from the remote-write exporter:
prometheus-bot: \n```
2026-03-17T08:12:34Z error remote_write: Post \"https://rw-proxy.internal/api/v1/write\": net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)
2026-03-17T08:12:36Z warn retrying remote_write (attempt=3) backoff=2s
```
alex: what changed during migration? I remember we flipped the proxy to use our new rw-proxy in west2 with stricter rate limits
mia: correct — proxy now enforces connection-concurrency=50 per src and we have ~120 scrape targets from gpu sidecars after autoscale
jon: autoscale + hostname relabeling hiccup may have temporarily exploded series cardinality (pod_uid not being dropped)
lisa: found relabel rules in the new prometheus config that accidentally preserved pod_name and pod_ip together — that could create dupe series across restarts
alex: can you paste the relabel snippet
lisa: \n```
- job_name: gpu-exporter
  kubernetes_sd_configs: []
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
    target_label: pod
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip]
    target_label: instance
  # MISSING: drop pod_uid to avoid per-restart series
```
mia: proposed quick fixes: 1) add write_relabel_config to drop pod_uid / container_id, 2) add per-job scrape_interval jitter, 3) temporarily increase proxy concurrency for west2 by 2x
jon: I'm for doing 1+2 immediately, 3 needs ops approval
alex: ops: @deploy-bot can we bump rw-proxy concurrency for west2 to 100 for 30m? This is to drain the scrape backlog while we fix relabeling
deploy-bot: scheduled action: increase rw-proxy concurrency for zone=west2 to 100 for 30 minutes — triggered by alex — job id 8421
mia: implemented relabel patch in staging and ran `promtool check config` then rolled to canary:
prometheus-bot: \n```
INFO: relabel rule applied: drop label 'pod_uid'
INFO: scrape_interval jitter enabled: 0-15s
```
jon: after canary, write latency p95 dropped from 18s -> 4s, error rate down ~85%
lisa: still seeing a few noisy targets — filebeat sidecars on some gpu nodes are spiking labels when pods restart
alex: followups: 1) ensure all gpu exporter jobs have write_relabel_config to drop ephemeral ids, 2) add an alert for remote_write_queue_length > 1000 for >5m, 3) docs: playbook for rw-proxy rate-limit surge
mia: I'll open the PR for relabel sweep and add the alert rule
jon: I'll draft the runbook and include the proxy escalation steps
lisa: ops note: consider adding token-bucket smoothing on autoscaler to avoid 100+ pods starting simultaneously
alex: thanks team. let's keep this thread for the rollouts. feel free to ping if anything regresses :thumbsup:
